about:
Café Athena has been serving Greek food on Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach since 1990. You'll find us at 1846 Garnet Ave, in the heart of PB, where neighbours and visitors come in for Greek and Mediterranean cooking, a full bar and cocktails. We're open every day from 11am, and our daily happy hour runs 3–6pm.

We want everyone at the table to have something to enjoy, so our menu includes gluten-free and vegan options. If you have a food allergy, please talk to our team before you order. Café Athena is also set up for groups, whether that's a birthday dinner, a work get-together or a family celebration. We host private events and offer catering, so we can come to you or welcome you to us. [OWNER TO CONFIRM: a sentence about signature dishes or what makes the food special]
